import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv', 
                           columns=['amount', 'is_fraud', 'transaction_type', 'hour_of_day'])

# Create a bar chart of transaction types by frequency
transaction_type_counts = credit_fraud['transaction_type'].value_counts()
sns.barplot(x=transaction_type_counts.index, y=transaction_type_counts.values)
plt.title('Transaction Type Frequency')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of amount distribution
sns.histplot(credit_fraud['amount'], binwidth=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Amount Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of amount vs hour of day
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=credit_fraud)
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of fraud cases by hour of day
fraud_cases_by_hour = credit_fraud['is_fraud'].value_counts()

sns.barplot(x=fraud_cases_by_hour.index, y=fraud_cases_by_hour.values)
plt.title('Fraud Cases by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
